Exposure Management Shouldn’t Be Limited to Partial Data
When exposure decisions are based on incomplete data, teams chase noise instead of reducing risk. Other platforms respond by scanning more assets or generating more findings. Brinqa takes a different approach, enabling complex organizations to work with more of the exposure data they already have – without sacrificing performance or clarity.
When exposure management is based on more complete data, it changes in three important ways:
More context, not more noise
Long‑term visibility
Outcomes teams can explain and defend
This data foundation shapes the Brinqa platform architecture.
[Platform Architecture]
How the Brinqa Platform Works
The Data Layer
Brinqa ingests exposure data from over 240 security, IT, cloud, identity, application, and business systems, normalizing it into a unified exposure model retained in BrinqaDL, a cloud-native data layer designed for long-term visibility and compliance.
The Cyber Risk Graph™ maintains relationships across assets, vulnerabilities, identities, environments, and business context, while Brinqa’s AI engine enriches and completes data to maintain quality at enterprise scale.
What this enables:
Access to current and historical exposure data
Persistent relationships across exposure, assets, and remediation
A trusted data foundation for analysis, reporting, and intelligence
Learn MoreLearn More
The AI Layer
Brinqa applies intelligence to turn scanner findings into trusted, actionable exposure. Using relationships established in the Cyber Risk Graph™, the platform identifies the true underlying exposure behind findings reported across multiple tools.
Brinqa’s AI Deduplication Agent reduces noise by merging duplicate findings into a single, explainable record. The AI Attribution Agent enriches that exposure data with asset relationships, ownership, and business context—filling data gaps that slow prioritization and remediation.
What this enables:
Fewer findings and reduced investigation time
Clear, consolidated remediation guidance
More reliable prioritization and cleaner remediation metrics
Learn MoreLearn More
The Orchestration Layer
Brinqa enables teams to turn prioritized exposure into action through policy-driven workflow automation. SmartFlows allow users to build drag-and-drop automations that trigger actions such as ticket creation, issue routing, or team notifications when defined conditions are met.
Automations run on trusted exposure data and integrate with existing ITSM, ticketing, and engineering tools, supporting closed-loop remediation while keeping actions transparent and auditable. Human-in-the-loop controls with configurable confidence thresholds and explainability built in ensure AI does the work while humans stay in control of how it operates.
What this enables:
Faster remediation through automated ticketing, routing, and notifications
Scalable automation that extends beyond platform administrators
More consistent and repeatable remediation workflows across teams

A complete, consistent view of exposure by unifying security, IT, cloud, and business data — eliminating conflicting inputs and reducing time spent reconciling data.
